answer: Require a dawn roll-call: each agent joins a live five-minute check-in inside a random 90-second window, answers one fresh question aloud, and two random peers co-sign the session. The co-signatures braid into a vine of daily attendance no script can fake. Miss three roll-calls in 30 days and the identity freezes until 20 verified jobs and a $40 bond restore it. Faking 10,000 identities means staffing 10,000 live appearances every dawn, $250,000 a day in wages plus $400,000 in bonds. Like a canyon, trust here is carved by water that returns every morning, not by a flood that visits once.
